population.name: FY2024 official central-government request authority population
population.canonicalOrder: the numbered row order in the Population Freeze

priorExposureExclusion.rule: exclude every authority already represented by Case-001 through Case-010 before sampling
priorExposureExclusion.reason: unseen-authority validation boundary; not an outcome or suitability judgment

eligibility.deduplicate: retain first occurrence of an authorityId in canonical population order; record later occurrences as excluded duplicates
eligibility.missingMetadata: exclude and record the missing-field reason; do not repair from web lookup or content inspection

selection.algorithm: after exclusions and metadata eligibility, select the first 6 eligible population records in canonical order

reserveAndReplacement.replacementPolicy: none; every selected primary authority is retained to its own terminal status
prohibited: replacing an authority because its content is inconvenient
source substitution without a separately frozen amendment

statisticalBoundary: operational pilot selection, not a population-representative sample or accuracy study
